freeze.model_selection: One fixed seed/configuration/final checkpoint; no validation-based tuning

limits: Exploratory composition partitions only; no independent product qualification.
Translation-only alignment; local inconsistency may be motion or illumination.
Reference stability and pair gates are provisional, not calibrated quality guarantees.
Single-image Haar MAD conditioning is a texture/correlation-affected proxy, not sensor truth.
No noisy input interpolation; reference interpolation correlates target noise.
Pair admission uses low-frequency source/reference consistency, not learned output or high-pass residual masking.
Reciprocal translation and global overlap do not prove local correspondence.
Global channel gains/offsets fit on five ROIs; require two consistent distinct monitoring ROIs.
Burst means retain fixed-pattern noise and are not perfectly clean targets.
MSE is measured against a noisy aligned burst reference, not an absolute clean truth.
No independent third composition, Lightroom equivalence, visual validation or production integration.
256 fixed steps; no validation-driven checkpoint or parameter selection.
CPU-only training; no GPU, full-frame inference, peak-memory or deployment qualification.
Exploratory two-composition pilot; no independent third scene or camera.
Training and validation may cover different ISOs; coverage is reported explicitly.
Patch counts are correlated samples, not independent scenes.
Reference averages are not perfectly clean sensor ground truth.
No display rendering, visual validation or production integration.
